card.title: This Is How It Ends
card.instruction: Treat every awkward pause, changed plan, or small disagreement as the possible beginning of permanent distance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've moved my chair away from yours. Shall I pack the books too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put it back. You can choose where.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside yours. Unless letting me choose means you're keeping your options open.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 reads a moved chair as departure preparation, A3 treats vacuuming as clearing A's place, and A5 questions whether offered choice means B is withholding commitment.

relationship.evidence: B2 provides a mundane cleaning reason and B4 offers to restore the chair wherever A wants.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's accommodating choice as another possible sign of distance after first choosing closeness.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's keeping-options-open turn is earned by the discretion B4 offers.
